catalog.title: Flagship Brand Experience

catalog.title: Interactive Editorial Investigation

catalog.requirement: 800–1,100 word feature; fixed six-district dataset; 3 data visualisations; linked interactions; accessible table; honest methodology

catalog.title: Commerce and Booking Marketplace

catalog.title: Operations Command Centre

catalog.title: Project Operations Workspace

catalog.title: Echo Courier — Original 2D Puzzle Game
catalog.summary: A deterministic tile puzzle in which a delayed echo repeats the player's previous four moves.

catalog.title: Parallax Archive — Interactive 3D World
catalog.summary: A procedural 3D exploration puzzle built around perspective, camera alignment and spatial discovery.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D geometry; orbit/zoom/selection; 4 distinct spatial puzzles; keyboard/touch; resize and WebGL failure handling

catalog.title: Living Systems Simulator
catalog.summary: A deterministic ecosystem simulation with specified coupled equations, scenarios, plots and CSV history export.
catalog.requirement: 4 coupled state variables; correct equations; fixed-step RK4; 3 scenarios; 5 live plots; deterministic controls; CSV export

catalog.title: Poster Foundry — Creative Production Studio
catalog.summary: A real browser-based vector poster editor with editable layers, transforms, undo/redo and export.
catalog.requirement: Editable text and 4+ shapes; synchronized layers; transform/style controls; undo/redo; save/import/export; valid SVG and PNG

catalog.title: Pulse Loom — Browser Music Workstation

catalog.requirement: 4 distinct synth voices; 16-step sequencer; tempo/swing/scales; mute/solo; drift-free clock; JSON round-trip; valid WAV export

catalog.title: Mosslight Isles — 3D Colony Builder
catalog.summary: A living 3D island settlement game with visible workers, road logistics, resource chains and a beacon-restoration goal.
catalog.requirement: Real 3D island; 12+ autonomous workers; 8 building types; 4 production chains; roads and pathfinding; stockpiles; save/load; staged objective

catalog.title: Voxel Wilds — Block Survival Sandbox

catalog.requirement: Real editable voxel world; 8 block types; mining/placement; inventory/hotbar; 5 crafting recipes; survival loop; world save/load; mobile controls

catalog.title: Skyline Circuit — 3D Arcade Racer

catalog.title: The Lantern Below — Action Roguelite
catalog.summary: A replayable top-down dungeon action game with connected procedural rooms, readable enemy telegraphs, weapon choices, relic builds and a boss.
catalog.requirement: Seeded 6-room run; guaranteed connectivity; 3 weapon styles; 4 enemy archetypes; relic upgrades; boss fight; dodge/combat; keyboard/touch; self-test
